course_name_original: Theory of mechanisms and machines -course project (2443)
course_name_en: Theory of mechanisms and machines - course project

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire and rationalize the general methods of research (analysis) and design (synthesis) of different types of mechanisms and machines.
Build practical skills to discover the main features of mechanisms.
Prepare for independent solving of specific engineering problems.

syllabus_topics: Structural and kinematical analysis of leverage mechanism
Optimisation geometric synthesis of gear mechanism
teaching_methods: Individual project work with methodological guidance
Use of calculation and simulation software

assessment_methods.method: Staged control and evaluation of calculation and graphic parts

assessment_rules: The calculation and graphic part of the project solutions are controlled in stages and evaluated based on their reliability and the way they have been explained, as well as on the analysis of the results obtained. The final grade for the project is formed after a public presentation.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
